key_insight: PPLC learns a patch-local latent representation that preserves turbulence physics while transferring zero-shot from low-resolution training data to higher-resolution 3D fields.
engineering_relevance: This enables much smaller storage and more scalable turbulence datasets without sacrificing key diagnostics needed for scientific computing and surrogate modeling.
method: Shared VAE applied independently to fixed-size patches
Exact mean preservation plus zero-mean fluctuation encoding
Invertible Haar wavelet front-end with shift-consistency regularization and overlap-aware reconstruction
evidence_signal: The model is trained on stride-downsampled 256^3 turbulence fields and evaluated zero-shot on 1024^3 fields, with improved agreement in dissipation, enstrophy, energy spectra, and incompressibility versus baselines.
watch_item: Patchwise transfer and overlap-based reconstruction may be sensitive to patch size, boundary effects, and whether the target flow remains within the assumed inertial-range similarity regime.
paper_title: Physics-Preserving Latent Compression for Zero-Shot Resolution Transfer in 3D Turbulence
